ios.desc:
Make your iPhone and iPad feel like yours with customizable Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Browse polished, ready-to-use designs, save one in a tap, or personalize every detail.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT WIDGET

Explore a gallery filled with distinctive clocks, calendars, photos, countdowns, quotes, colors, and activity designs. Each design is presented in the formats where it works best, so you can choose with confidence.

Add a design exactly as it appears or customize it before saving.

MAKE IT YOURS

Depending on the design, you can personalize:

• Fonts and typography
• Background, text, and accent colors
• Clock and date formats
• Quotes and custom text
• Countdown titles and dates
• Photos and visual styles
• Health and activity presentation

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS

Create beautiful widgets for the Home Screen, including:

• Clocks and calendars
• Photo widgets
• Quotes and custom text
• Event countdowns
• Step count
• Resting heart rate
• Solid color widgets
• Design inspiration

Different ideas need different amounts of space. Widgetly only offers the sizes appropriate for each design, helping every widget remain readable and balanced.

LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS

Browse a separate collection designed specifically for the Lock Screen. Choose from Inline, Circular, and Rectangular designs for:

• Date and time
• Countdowns
• Step count
• Resting heart rate

These are purpose-built compositions—not Home Screen designs squeezed into a smaller space.

YOUR DESIGNS, ORGANIZED

Save gallery designs with one tap and find them in My Widgets. Widgetly automatically gives each new widget a useful name, and you can rename or customize it whenever you want.

HEALTH DATA AND PRIVACY

Step Count and Resting Heart Rate widgets use HealthKit. Widgetly requests access only when you choose a Health design and only reads the data needed for that widget. Your Health data remains private and is used to display your widgets.

FREE AND PRO

The free version lets you save up to two widgets. Widgetly Pro is an optional one-time lifetime purchase that unlocks unlimited saved widgets, premium designs, and premium customization options. No subscription is required.

HOW TO ADD A HOME SCREEN WIDGET

1. Choose a design from the Gallery.
2. Add it immediately or customize it.
3. Long-press your Home Screen and add Widgetly from the widget gallery.
4. Long-press the new widget, choose Edit Widget, and select your saved design.
